lg-main-input.title: FA-605 · Main input harness with both plugs
lg-main-input.short_title: Main input harness with both plugs

main_input.label: FA-605 · Main input harness with both plugs

manual.title: Dock the prepared foot
manual.body: Complete the foot manual, then use its carrier to dock the prepared foot on the supported leg. The rail holder supports the foot and locks ankle motion during structural work.

manual.title: Lower the structural shin
manual.body: Use the shin rack controls to lower LG-100 onto the already fitted foot adapter. Align the female key with the adapter tongue; the equipment carries the load while it is unbolted.

manual.title: Secure the ankle flange
manual.body: Fit four W-36 washers on the LG-100 flange, then four H-36090 M36 × 90 bolts downward into the already fitted FA-201 adapter. Heads are accessible above the flange outside the narrow shin beam.

manual.title: Connect the shin disconnect
manual.body: Fit FA-605 as one main input harness, including both attached plugs. Seat its box end in the already fitted FA-604 main socket, follow the existing foot guide clips, then push its upper keyed plug into the angled socket integral to LG-100 beside the ankle flange. Undo this step to unplug the harness before separating foot and shin.

manual.title: Seat bearings and thrust spacers
manual.body: Fit both LG-130 journal bearings from opposite sides into the already fitted shin's circular knee boss. Add one LG-135 thrust spacer against each boss end. The two bearings share one type; the two spacers share another.

manual.title: Fork and axle
manual.body: Use the fork rack to straddle the already fitted shin boss with LG-110. Insert LG-140 from the left side through the aligned fork and bearings until its shoulder rests against the fork. The rail holder keeps the unpowered knee straight.

manual.title: Retain the knee axle
manual.body: Fit LG-150 on the exposed axle end. Fit two LG-W12 washers and two LG-H12050 screws from the right side into the axle end pad. Both screw heads remain outside the fork.

manual.title: Join the thigh spar
manual.body: Use the service crane to lower LG-120 onto the already fitted LG-110 fork flange. The hip ball and neck are integral to LG-120. Fit four LG-W24 washers and four LG-H24100 bolts downward through the exposed flange corners.

manual.title: Structural leg ready
manual.body: The load-bearing prototype is structurally ready. Use the leg rail to carry it to the pelvis gantry. Knee and ankle transport braces belong to the handling equipment; powered knee and hip actuators, services, armor and calf thrusters remain deferred. Open the pelvis manual for seating and retention.

manual.title: Seat the supported leg
manual.body: The braced pelvis bridge and both bolted socket housings are already fitted on the gantry. With the left ring removed, use the leg rail to dock the LG-120 hip ball upward into the left socket's open underside. Keep rail support until all retaining bolts are fitted.

diagram_views.title: Ball enters open left socket from below

manual.title: Fit the split retaining ring
manual.body: Carry and fit both PV-120 semicircular halves around the already seated LG-120 neck from opposite sides. Either identical half fits either destination. Their inward lips capture the ball with clearance around the neck.

manual.title: Bolt the ring to the socket
manual.body: Fit four LG-W24 washers and four PV-H24140 bolts upward from the split ring's exposed underside into the left socket flange. Both halves must be fitted and all four bolts installed before releasing rail support. To remove the leg, reacquire rail support first, then reverse the retention steps.

diagram_views.title: Bolt the ring to the socket

manual.title: Left leg structurally mounted
manual.body: The left ball is captured by both bolted ring halves. The gantry and mechanical transport braces support this unpowered prototype. This is structural readiness; hydraulic actuators, services and armor remain deferred.

manual.title: Foot workshop
manual.body: Prepare both FA-302 heel pads and FA-500-P (pitch actuator). Use the foot bay controls to expose each side. Follow each branch to install and secure it before transferring the foot.

manual.title: Heel position 1
manual.body: Seat a prepared FA-302 here. At each connection, fit W-24 (washer) before H-24120 (bolt). Stock the hardware from its drawers and select the matching pocket. Any connection order works.

manual.title: Heel position 2
manual.body: Seat a prepared FA-302 here. At each connection, fit W-24 (washer) before H-24120 (bolt). Stock the hardware from its drawers and select the matching pocket. Any connection order works.

manual.title: Cradle clevis
manual.body: Carry FA-220 (cradle clevis) from its shelf and fit it to FA-103. Secure it with two W-24 washers and two H-24070 bolts.

manual.title: Ring clevis
manual.body: Carry FA-220 (ring clevis) from its shelf and fit it to FA-200. Secure it with two W-24 washers and two H-24070 bolts.

manual.title: Seat & pin actuator
manual.body: Carry the prepared FA-500-P and seat it here. At each end fit FA-221 (pin), FA-222 (keeper), W-12, then H-12030. The FA-500-P child manual covers its preparation.
